S-Cleaner — Starting selection brief
Manufacturer: Boya Gongdao

A 2 m autonomous catamaran that detects and collects floating debris in harbours, reservoirs, rivers and scenic waters, using lidar and cameras to avoid obstacles.

Dimensions: 2 × 1.3 m catamaran
Draught: ≤ 80 cm
Minimum water depth: 1 m
Debris capacity: ≥ 50 kg
Rated coverage: ≥ 10,000 m²/h
Speed: Max ≥ 4 kn; working 1–2 m/s
Endurance: 6–8 h
Hull: Fibreglass + aluminium

Configuration note: The portable control terminal (S-RTU) is standard; the S-Wharf docking station and S-Center remote control centre are optional. Interfaces are reserved for side-scan sonar, multi-parameter water-quality sensors, multibeam bathymetry and ADCP; confirm the specific sensors offered.

Confirm current specifications and delivered scope with the manufacturer before purchase.
